answer.new_information: No stored pieces or catalog questions are linked to this record, and the covered scope is NVDA only. NN, Inc. is a supplier, not a covered name. The record reports NN's own announcement of 47 machine centers at its Wuxi plant for NVIDIA liquid cooling racks, with 100% of new capacity pre-sold (party claim, no original-source date given, event late June 2026). The US$80-90 million 2026 new-business target is a company target, not a result. The US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings by 2028 are a Simply Wall St style narrative projection, and the US$489.5m and US$48.3m figures are unnamed analysts' rumoured estimates. None of these is a 2026 NVDA figure, so they do not match any NVDA period or definition. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is a fact item with no linked question.
